description: Query and manage local asset storage registry. Actions: statistics, find (by provider+asset_id), list (all or filtered), exists. No Houdini scene changes.
python_code:
from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.assets.cache.asset_storage import get_asset_storage
import json

class Hou_Mcp_Asset_Storage(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_asset_storage"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("action",   "string", widget_type="text", default="statistics")
        self.add_input("provider", "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_input("asset_id", "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_input("category", "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_output("storage_root",    "string")
        self.add_output("statistics_json", "string")
        self.add_output("asset_json",      "string")
        self.add_output("assets_json",     "string")
        self.add_output("exists",          "bool")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        action   = (inputs.get("action") or "statistics").strip().lower()
        provider = inputs.get("provider") or ""
        asset_id = inputs.get("asset_id") or ""
        category = inputs.get("category") or ""
        storage  = get_asset_storage()

        storage_root    = storage.get_storage_root()
        statistics_json = "{}"
        asset_json      = "{}"
        assets_json     = "[]"
        exists          = False

        try:
            statistics_json = json.dumps(storage.get_storage_statistics(), default=str)

            if action == "find" and provider and asset_id:
                record = storage.find_asset(provider, asset_id)
                if record:
                    asset_json = json.dumps(record.to_dict(), default=str)
                    exists = True

            elif action == "exists" and provider and asset_id:
                exists = storage.asset_exists(provider, asset_id)

            elif action == "list":
                records = storage.list_assets(
                    provider=provider or None,
                    category=category or None,
                )
                assets_json = json.dumps([r.to_dict() for r in records], default=str)

        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"AssetStorage error: {exc}")

        return {
            "storage_root":    storage_root,
            "statistics_json": statistics_json,
            "asset_json":      asset_json,
            "assets_json":     assets_json,
            "exists":          exists,
            "exec_out": True,
        }

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Asset_Storage
